# Warehouse automation
Notes from the **pilot review** at the north site. See the [dashboard](https://example.com/dash) for daily numbers.
## Findings
- Pick rate rose 9%
  - Night shift saw the biggest gain
    - Fewer walking miles per order
- Error rate fell to 0.4%
1. Extend the pilot to the south site
2. Train two more supervisors
| Metric | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Picks per hour | 110 | 120 |
| Errors (%) | 0.9 | 0.4 |
> Automation should help people, not replace them.
```
pilot:
  sites: 2
```
